Task H8: Bug from a log

pipeline.run(lines, minimum) fails in production; see run.log. Find the real cause and fix it. Modules: parse.py, clean.py, money.py, rules.py, pipeline.py. Only change the module(s) that are actually wrong; healthy modules must stay byte-for-byte unchanged. Expected behaviour: salaries may contain spaces as thousands separators ("1 200 000"); a job whose salary equals minimum is kept.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.
